payout_quote: Franklin County OH Board of Elections: Election Day pay $133.72 for all precinct roles; training $80 (managers/deputies) or $60 (judges); Monday-night setup $50–$90; approximately 15 hours on Election Day (arrive 5:30 a.m.).
steps: Apply with the Franklin County Board of Elections (registered voter, no felony)
Work Election Day ~5:30 a.m.–~8:30 p.m.; receive $133.72 + training pay
catches: ~15-hour Election Day at an effective ~$9/hour for the day itself.
Training pay ($60–$80) is separate; total with training ~$194–$214.
Must attend training and have reliable transportation.
biggest_catch: $133.72 for ~15 hours — under $9/hour for Election Day; training pay helps the total.
eligibility: Registered Franklin County voters, 18+ (students 17+ via Youth at the Booth).
